runtime.name: Supermium
runtime.releaseNotes: Official R2.01 release. Fixes PDF display problems on Windows Vista and 7 and a default-protocol registration issue on some systems.
runtime.distributionNotes: Copy the complete Supermium archive directory, preserving the version subdirectory and bundled DLLs. Do not run the archive-root setup.exe. Reproduce the Chromium copyright, license conditions, and disclaimer in distribution materials; preserve bundled third-party credits.

verification.method: GitHub API release asset IDs, sizes, URLs and SHA-256 digest fields were checked against v150-r2.01. The complete packaged x86 ZIP was downloaded and its SHA-256 and size matched the official asset. Its ZIP entries and x86 chrome.exe path were inspected. The official Chromium 150.0.7871.255 license file SHA-256 was verified. The x64 asset is pinned for source tracking and is not packaged.

compatibilityReferences.notes: Supermium explicitly supports Windows 7 and supplies x86 and x64 builds. The existing Bulka web release uses dart2js and CanvasKit, so WasmGC is not required for its Dart application code. CanvasKit still uses WebAssembly; its engine has CPU rendering fallback when WebGL initialization fails. Chromium 150 also exceeds Flutter's documented WasmGC baseline of Chromium 119 if a future Bulka release enables Dart Wasm compilation. WebGL, software-rendering fallback, codecs, touch input, and all application workflows still require execution testing on representative Windows 7 devices; this lock is not certification by the Flutter team. Supermium does not automatically update, so runtime updates are now announced inside Bulka Staff and delivered by a reviewed Bulka installer release.
